skill.name: douyin-topic-analysis
skill.description: Use SocialDataX to review Douyin's current hot-search list and sample posts by keyword. Compare the results to develop short-video topics.
skill.summary: Turn Douyin trends and keyword search samples into content ideas supported by source references.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts match Markdown or documentation rather than executable syntax, leaked secrets, or obfuscation. The CLI workflow runs an unpinned npm package that can access credentials in its execution environment. The shell example does not explain how to keep user input separate from shell syntax.

remediation.issue: CLI setup and search invoke an unpinned npm package.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed CLI version, verify its integrity, and obtain user approval before downloading or executing it. Use the same reviewed version for login, status, and search.

remediation.issue: The CLI can access an API key from the environment or a persistent local credential file.
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated, revocable key and isolate the CLI from unrelated environment secrets. Keep credential entry outside the agent and enforce owner-only file access.

remediation.issue: The search example gives no safe method for passing user input and pagination tokens to the CLI.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer structured MCP parameters or pass values as separate process arguments with the shell disabled. Do not interpolate keywords or tokens into shell command strings.

content.value_statement: A trending term alone does not show which content formats or topics fit your audience. Compare current Douyin trends with keyword search samples to find ideas worth testing.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve the current Douyin hot-search ranking without a keyword.
Search Douyin posts by keyword and sort by recency or likes.
Filter keyword results by publication window, duration, or content type.
Use a page or item limit in the CLI, or continue with a pagination token when available.
Summarize relevant examples and content ideas while preserving returned links, IDs, or other source details.
limitations: Live data requires a configured SocialDataX connection or an authenticated CLI. Searches may consume provider credits.
Search samples are not exhaustive and may be incomplete when a request fails.
Results do not establish why a post performed well or predict future engagement.
The workflow does not publish posts, like content, comment, or modify Douyin accounts.

use_cases.title: Plan a Weekly Content Calendar
use_cases.description: Compare current hot searches with relevant keyword examples before choosing topics for the next publishing week.

use_cases.title: Review Brand Mentions
use_cases.description: Find recent posts about a brand or product and record the claims, themes, and source references.

use_cases.title: Find Short Video Formats
use_cases.description: Study short videos in a niche and turn recurring formats into original concepts to test.

prompt_templates.title: Check Current Douyin Trends
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the top five entries on the current Douyin hot-search list. Label them as current ranking signals.

prompt_templates.title: Sample One Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Douyin for small kitchen storage and review one page. List relevant posts with titles and source references where available. Suggest two follow-up questions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Short Video Formats
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Douyin videos under one minute about balcony gardening from the past week. Sort by likes and review up to ten results. Separate observed formats from suggested ideas.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Cited Topic Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize today's hot-search list separately from searches for bicycle maintenance and commuter cycling. Review up to two pages per keyword. Include source references, note gaps, and propose three original video topics.

output_examples.input: Review one page of Douyin results for small kitchen storage.
output: Illustrative sample: Posts show drawer dividers and under-sink storage.
Suggested topic: Compare two storage layouts for the same cabinet.
Scope: One page of keyword results, not the Douyin hot-search list.

output_examples.input: Compare the hot-search list with recent short videos about balcony gardening.
output: Illustrative trend snapshot: Balcony gardening did not appear in the top five hot-search entries.
Keyword sample: Container selection and watering schedules appeared in separate posts.
Suggested topic: Demonstrate a watering routine for a small balcony. The sample does not predict engagement.

best_practices: Start with one page and set a result limit before requesting more.
Keep hot-search rankings separate from keyword results and distinguish observations from recommendations.
Keep available source references and publication dates so readers can check the evidence.
anti_patterns: Treating one page of results as representative of all Douyin posts.
Treating high likes or a hot-search position as proof of what caused engagement.
Pasting API keys into chat or including confidential details in search terms.

faq.question: Do I need a keyword to see what is trending?
faq.answer: No. The current hot-search list is separate from keyword search.

faq.question: What do I need for live Douyin results?
faq.answer: Use an authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection or configure a SocialDataX API key in a trusted CLI environment. Do not share your key in chat.

faq.question: Can I search for only videos or only image posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Keyword search supports content type filters for videos and image posts.

faq.question: What happens if the account runs out of credits?
faq.answer: Search calls can stop. Any partial results should be marked incomplete. Verify the account in the provider dashboard before deciding whether to add credits.

faq.question: How do I improve weak keyword results?
faq.answer: Try a clearer term or remove a filter. If results are too broad, add an audience, use case, or time window.

faq.question: Can the skill publish a video or change my Douyin account?
faq.answer: No. Its Douyin operations are limited to research and do not publish, like, comment, or modify accounts.
